bio: Van life across Canada and the Pacific coast. Campfires, coffee on the tailgate and roads without a plan.
avatar: Portrait of a woman in her early 30s with a wool beanie and windswept hair, forest campsite behind her, sunlit freckles, shoulders-up, photographic, fictional person
banner: Ultra-wide panoramic photograph of a camper van parked beside a mountain lake at sunrise with mist on the water, subject across the middle band, cinematic

collections.title: On the road
videos: Building a bed that folds away

videos.title: Coffee on the tailgate
videos.description: A kettle, a view and nowhere to be.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of a camper van's open back doors with a steaming coffee pot on a camp stove and a misty mountain lake view, no people, warm light, no text
videos.motion: Steam rises from the coffee pot and mist drifts over the lake, slow camera push-in.

videos.title: Campfire, marshmallows, stars
videos.description: A fire crackling under the Milky Way.
videos.still: Wide photograph of a campfire in a forest clearing at night with a camper van and the Milky Way above the trees, people as small silhouettes, no text
videos.motion: Fire flickers, sparks rise and stars twinkle in the sky, slow camera tilt.

videos.title: Building a bed that folds away
videos.description: Plywood, hinges and a very small bedroom.
videos.still: Vertical photograph of the interior of a camper van with a wooden fold-away bed being built, hands holding a drill, warm light, no face, no text
videos.motion: The hands lower the wooden bed frame and tighten a screw, light shifts, subtle camera drift.

videos.title: Coastal highway, windows down
videos.description: A van on a cliff road above the surf.
videos.still: Wide aerial-style photograph of a camper van driving along a curving coastal highway above turquoise surf at golden hour, no text
videos.motion: The van drives along the cliff road, the surf sparkles below, slow tracking camera.
